observations: Round wooden dining table with a sunburst veneer pattern.
Four chairs with black padded seats and backs, featuring curved wooden backrests.
A circular glass lazy susan is integrated into the center of the table.
The table has a central pedestal base.
Chairs have thin metal frames and legs.
A watermark 'ALPHA SOLAR ENERGY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.

risks.proof: A photo of the set with a handwritten note showing the seller's name and today's date.

risks.risk: Table surface may be thin veneer prone to peeling
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the table edge.

risks.risk: Lazy susan mechanism may be stuck or rough
risks.proof: Video of the glass center being rotated.

risks.risk: Pedestal base may be unstable or wobbly

proof_requests: Photo of the dining set with a handwritten note containing your name and today's date to verify possession.
Video showing the lazy susan rotating smoothly.
Close-up photos of the chair upholstery and table edges to check for wear.
response.reason: The watermark on the photo belongs to a solar energy company, which is a significant red flag suggesting the photo may not belong to the seller. Proof of possession is mandatory before pricing.
